class.name: OcgGpAx2d
class.brief_description: Describes an axis in the plane (2D space). An axis is defined by: - its origin (also referred to as its "Location point"), and - its unit vector (referred to as its "Direction"). An axis implicitly defines a direct, right-handed coordinate system in 2D space by: - its origin, - its "Direction" (giving the "X Direction" of the coordinate system), and - the unit vector normal to "Direction" (positive angle measured in the trigonometric sense). An axis is used: - to describe 2D geometric entities (for example, the axis which defines angular coordinates on a circle). It serves for the same purpose as the STEP function "axis placement one axis", or - to define geometric transformations (axis of symmetry, axis of rotation, and so on). Note: to define a left-handed 2D coordinate system, use gp_Ax22d.

method.name: default
method.description: Creates an axis object representing X axis of the reference co-ordinate system.

method.name: from_2
method.description: Creates an Ax2d. <theP> is the "Location" point of the axis placement and theV is the "Direction" of the axis placement.

method.name: SetLocation
method.description: Changes the "Location" point (origin) of <me>.

method.name: SetDirection
method.description: Changes the direction of <me>.

method.name: Location
method.description: Returns the origin of <me>.

method.name: Direction
method.description: Returns the direction of <me>.

method.name: IsCoaxial
method.description: Returns True if : . the angle between <me> and <Other> is lower or equal to <AngularTolerance> and . the distance between <me>.Location() and <Other> is lower or equal to <LinearTolerance> and . the distance between <Other>.Location() and <me> is lower or equal to LinearTolerance.

method.name: IsNormal
method.description: Returns true if this axis and the axis theOther are normal to each other. That is, if the angle between the two axes is equal to Pi/2 or -Pi/2. Note: the tolerance criterion is given by theAngularTolerance.

method.name: IsOpposite
method.description: Returns true if this axis and the axis theOther are parallel, and have opposite orientations. That is, if the angle between the two axes is equal to Pi or -Pi. Note: the tolerance criterion is given by theAngularTolerance.

method.name: IsParallel
method.description: Returns true if this axis and the axis theOther are parallel, and have either the same or opposite orientations. That is, if the angle between the two axes is equal to 0, Pi or -Pi. Note: the tolerance criterion is given by theAngularTolerance.

method.name: Angle
method.description: Computes the angle, in radians, between this axis and the axis theOther. The value of the angle is between -Pi and Pi.

method.name: Reverse
method.description: Reverses the direction of <me> and assigns the result to this axis.

method.name: Reversed
method.description: Computes a new axis placement with a direction opposite to the direction of <me>.

method.name: Mirrored_1
method.description: Performs the symmetrical transformation of an axis placement with respect to the point P which is the center of the symmetry.

method.name: Mirrored_2
method.description: Performs the symmetrical transformation of an axis placement with respect to an axis placement which is the axis of the symmetry.

method.name: Rotated
method.description: Rotates an axis placement. <theP> is the center of the rotation. theAng is the angular value of the rotation in radians.

method.name: Scaled
method.description: Applies a scaling transformation on the axis placement. The "Location" point of the axisplacement is modified. The "Direction" is reversed if the scale is negative.

method.name: Transformed
method.description: Transforms an axis placement with a Trsf.

method.name: Translated_1
method.description: Translates an axis placement in the direction of the vector theV. The magnitude of the translation is the vector's magnitude.

method.name: Translated_2
method.description: Translates an axis placement from the point theP1 to the point theP2.

method.name: DumpJson
method.description: Dumps the content of me into the stream
